svg.aria-label: Certified Blind. Illustrative filter: five of six orange points are discarded as the threshold rises, leaving ghosts below the threshold while the aggregate check passes throughout.

g.text: A filter that throws data away for
good can be poisoned to remove
most of one slice while its aggregate
before the discard, can detect it.
Illustrative data. The aggregate check sees only the points that clear τ.
